command_alternative.apt: sudo apt update; sudo apt -y upgrade

command_alternative.dnf: dnf search openjdk | awk -v arch=$(uname -m) '$0 ~ "openjdk\\." arch {split($1, a, "-"); print a[1] "-" a[2]}'
command_alternative.apt: apt-cache search openjdk | awk '$0 ~ "[0-9]{1,2}-jdk -" { split($1, a, "-"); print a[1] "-" a[2] }'
command_alternative.pacman: pacman -Ss jre | grep -E jre'([0-9]{0,2})'-openjdk'\s[0-9]{1,2}' | awk -F '[-]' '{print $1}' | awk -F 'jre' '{print $2}'
